platform: OverClocked ReMix Curated Video Game Arrangement Submission
manual_review_reason: OverClocked ReMix accepts only substantial, original arrangements of qualifying music actually used in a video, computer or arcade game. The upload must be a final WAV at least 16-bit/44.1 kHz stereo, normally 2-7 minutes, with an original title, identifiable source material and complete collaborator credits. Prompt-based generative AI, including Suno and Udio, is prohibited. Submission grants OverClocked ReMix a non-exclusive, sublicensable, perpetual and universal distribution/performance license, while removal is generally not guaranteed. A human must verify source eligibility, derivative-work and sample rights, production provenance, collaborator consent, the broad license, the one-at-a-time/two-week limits and all live form fields before uploading. If the public form is inaccessible, the official fallback requires forum registration and must remain owner-controlled.
